vsftpd.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 contains a backdoor that opens a shell on port 6200 when a specific username pattern is used during login.
vsftpd.recommendation: Upgrade vsftpd immediately to version 2.3.5 or later. Audit all FTP accounts and consider switching to SFTP.

vsftpd.description: ALPACA attack: vsftpd before 3.0.4 is vulnerable to cross-protocol attacks exploiting TLS session confusion.
vsftpd.recommendation: Upgrade vsftpd to 3.0.4+. Disable plain FTP and enforce FTPS (explicit or implicit TLS).

openssh.description: Remote code execution via ssh-agent when the agent is forwarded to an attacker-controlled server. Exploitable without authentication.
openssh.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.3p2 or later. Disable ssh-agent forwarding (AllowAgentForwarding no) unless strictly required.

openssh.description: regreSSHion: Race condition in OpenSSH sshd signal handler allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems.
openssh.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.8p1 immediately. Set LoginGraceTime to 0 in sshd_config as a temporary mitigation.

apache httpd.description: Path traversal and remote code execution on Apache 2.4.49. An attacker can map URLs to files outside the document root.
apache httpd.recommendation: Upgrade Apache to 2.4.50+. Ensure 'Require all denied' in Directory blocks. Disable CGI if not needed.

apache httpd.description: Apache mod_proxy fails to send X-Forwarded-* headers to backends on hop-by-hop header abuse, enabling IP origin bypass.
apache httpd.recommendation: Upgrade Apache to 2.4.55. Audit all reverse proxy configurations.

apache httpd.description: Potential SSRF via mod_rewrite in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.59 and earlier allows URL redirection to arbitrary hosts.
apache httpd.recommendation: Upgrade Apache to 2.4.67. Review all mod_rewrite rules for open redirect patterns.

nginx.description: One-byte memory overwrite in the DNS resolver of nginx allows remote attackers to cause denial of service or potentially execute code.
nginx.recommendation: Upgrade nginx to 1.21.0+. Restrict DNS resolver access and prefer internal resolvers.

openssl.description: Infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt() when processing malicious certificates. Causes denial of service.
openssl.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 3.0.2+ or 1.1.1n+. Monitor certificate inputs.

openssl.description: Buffer overflow in X.509 certificate verification. Can cause denial of service.
openssl.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSL to 3.0.7 immediately. Apply vendor security patches.

samba.description: SambaCry: Remote code execution via writable share. Attacker uploads a shared library and triggers execution.
samba.recommendation: Upgrade Samba to 4.6.4+. Set 'nt pipe support = no' as temporary mitigation. Restrict writable shares.

mysql.description: Authentication bypass: a memcmp timing vulnerability allows brute-force login with ~256 attempts regardless of password.
mysql.recommendation: Upgrade MySQL to 5.6.6+. Apply the security patch immediately and rotate all database credentials.

proftpd.description: Remote code execution via mod_copy: unauthenticated users can copy arbitrary files on the server.
proftpd.recommendation: Upgrade ProFTPD to 1.3.5+. Disable mod_copy module. Migrate to SFTP.
